summary: Explains setting manifest.omit_default_directives to true to skip the defaults, in which case you must supply the full directive list yourself, with an example.
questions: How do I turn off the default manifest directives completely?
What do I need to include if I omit the default directives?

answer_card.title: Omit default manifest directives
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `omit_default_directives: true` and provide the full list yourself:
```yaml
manifest:
  directives:
    - include meta/runtime.yml
    - include README.md LICENSE
    - recursive-include plugins */**.py
    - exclude galaxy.yml MANIFEST.json FILES.json <namespace>-<name>-*.tar.gz
    - recursive-exclude tests/output **
  omit_default_directives: true
```
